page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; numbered marginal notes in the right margin; running head with page number at the top; gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: cias[?] depopulantes, SARACENI militarunt: quibus de-628. victis, cum his Heraclii quaestores dare stipendia recu-sarent; dictitantes, non tantum sibi esse pecuniae, ut huic canum turbae satisfacerent: SARACENI ab Impe-630.rio Romano deficientes, Aegyptum, Hierosolymam,636. Syriam, Mesopotamiam, Persidem, totamque Asiam,seqq. & tandem Aphricam quoque invaserunt, sibique sub-669.jugarunt: & quanquam saepe a Romanis illorum audacia repressa est: ad extremum tamen, dilacerato civilibus discordiis odiisque intestinis Romano Imperio, Saraceni has provincias, pulsis undique Caesareis praefidiis, retinuerunt: unde postea crebras in Hispaniam, Galliam, Siciliam & Italiam irruptiones fecerunt. Bello intestino inter MUHAMEDUM & HABDALLAM fratres exorto, Saracenorum res utplurimum funt labefactatae, & in plura dominia distractae: ita ut unus Hispaniam, alter Aphricam, tertius Aegyptum, quartus Syriam & Palaestinam obtineret. Elapsis aliquot annis,698. exardescente inter Persas & Saracenos bello, MAHOMETES Persiae Sulthanus, Pissasirio Syriae & Babyloniae Caliphā viribus inferior, TURCAS vicinos adversus illum excitavit: eorumque fide ac robore victoriam adeptus, cum stipendia illis promissa solvere recusaret: ab illis ipsis suis auxiliariis bello petitus, victusque regno est privatus. TURCI igitur Persidis regno potiti, cum701. SARACENORUM potentiam bellis intestinis languefactam cernerent: paulatim plures in Asia regiones & provincias subegerunt: donec tandem proprio Principe, sive Imperatore electo Tangrolipezo Mucaleto (Haithonus Zadocum nominat) excusso Saracenorum jugo, iisque oppressis, primum dominari in Persia & reliquis Asiae provinciis usque ad Pontum Euxinum coeperunt. Tribus ab hinc elapsis seculis, cum Joannes PALAEOLOGUS Imp. Constantinopolitanus bellis Bulgaricis & Servianis nimiū urgeretur: turpe foedus cum870. AMURATHE Turca init: adeo ut & se & Imperium in fidem ejus traderet, promisso tributo, quod ille constituerat: & Theodorum filium natu minimum obsidem871.

page.notes: Marginal numerals on the right (628, 630, 636, seqq., 669, 698, 701, 870, 871, 1044, 1368 in the scan) are dates/section references; some are hard to read at this scan quality and are transcribed as best possible. The margin item "1044." and "1368." appear at the bottom of the right margin and were not placed inline. The word "cias" at the start is uncertain. The "Ii 2" signature and running head "FIOS VI." are uncertain in their exact letterforms. The printed "Caliphā" and "nimiū" follow the scan's spelling. The line "Maho-METES" is printed as split across lines.
